# One format string per line. These pin the dialect: whatever the evaluator
# is, it must render every one of these identically.
#
# Values are already substituted, the way _value_from_tag_format does it,
# so these are exactly what parseString() receives.
$upper('abc')
$lower('ABC')
$num('7','3')
$num('','2')
$substr('abcdefgh','2','5')
$substr('abcdefgh','','-3')
$strchr('hello','l')
$contains('Hello World','World')
$contains('Hello World','world')
$icontains('Hello World','world')
$strcmp('a','a')
$strcmp('a','b')
$stricmp('A','a')
$valid('x')
$valid('')
$neg($valid(''))
$any($valid(''),$valid('x'))
$all($valid('x'),$valid('y'))
$all($valid('x'),$valid(''))
$if1($valid('x'),'yes','no')
$if1($valid(''),'yes','no')
$if1($valid('x'),'yes')
$if2('','fallback')
$if2('given','fallback')
$if3('','','third')
$ifeq('a','a','same','diff')
$ifeq('a','b','same','diff')
$ieq('A','a','same','diff')
$ifequal(2,2,'eq','ne')
$ifgreater(3,2,'gt','le')
$ifgreater(2,3,'gt','le')
$switch('2','1','one','2','two','other')
$switch('9','1','one','2','two','other')
$iswitch('BOOTLEG','bootleg','B','promo','P','')
$wrap('x','[',']')
$wrap('','[',']')
$wrap('x',' (')
$inarray('["Box Set", "Limited Edition"]','Box Set')
$inarray('["Box Set"]','Numbered')
$flatten('["A","B","C"]','0','')
$flatten('["A","B","C"]',':2',' / ')
$flatten('["A","B","C"]',':',' + ')
# nesting, which is the whole point
$if1($neg($strcmp('Artist','Artist')),'Artist - ')
$if1($neg($strcmp('Artist','Other')),'Artist - ')
$ifgreater('2',1,$ieq('vinyl','vinyl','Disk','CD'),'')
$if1($strcmp('','',),'','')
# python's + operator, which eval() made available
$ieq('vinyl','vinyl','Disk','CD')+' '+$num('2','1')
# escaped parens
$wrap('x',' \(','\)')
# text around and between calls
prefix $upper('a') middle $lower('B') suffix
# an unknown function
$nosuchfunction('a')
